question: Who among the following is a famous veena player?
solution:
The correct answer is __**V. Dhannamal**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Veenai Dhannamal (1867–1938) **was a celebrated veena player in Carnatic music.**
 
• She **belonged to a lineage of exceptional musicians and was known for her nuanced and expressive playing style.**
 
• She pioneered a distinctive style of veena playing, often referred to as the **Dhannamal Bani** (school/style), which emphasized gamakas (ornamentation) and subtle artistry.
 
• **Her music greatly influenced the evolution of Carnatic instrumental music.**
